title: Knight Dialer
description: Calculate number of distinct phone numbers of length n a knight can dial.
pseudocode:
1. If n == 1, return 10
2. Initialize dp array of size 10 with 1s
3. Repeat n-1 times: compute new_dp based on knight moves
4. Sum the elements in dp array

steps.note: Since n is 1, return the total count of 10 digits
